instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\base.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\slider.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\stop1.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\stop2.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\pin.dxf. Import base.dxf, slider.dxf, pin.dxf, stop1.dxf, and stop2.dxf. Draw an optimized slide assembly: base rectangle (0,0)-(220,45), slider rectangle (80,55)-(140,95), stop rectangles (45,55)-(65,95) and (155,55)-(175,95), pin circle at (110,75) radius 7, travel CENTER line from (55,75) to (165,75), and text ACAD-38. Use OUTLINE for base, slider, and stop rectangles, HOLE for the pin circle, CENTER for the travel line, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
